qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the pump assembly to metal-bonded mount?
What torque should be applied to the holder to fuel pump or fuel reservoir?
What is the torque specification for M4 electric connections on fuel pump?
What torque value is specified for M5 electric connections on fuel pump?
Which components have a torque specification of 2 Nm?
qa_pairs.answer: Electric connections on fuel pump (3AZ), plastic nut on cover for fuel pipes (6AZ), and hose clamps 10 - 16 mm dia. (7AZ)

qa_pairs.question: What vehicle types apply to most of the fuel supply specifications?
What section and subsection does this torque specification table cover?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 16-2 Fuel tank and fuel lines, subsection 16 12 Fuel Supply

qa_pairs.question: Which specification requires the highest torque value in this fuel supply table?
qa_pairs.answer: The pump assembly to metal-bonded mount (1AZ) and holder to fuel pump or fuel reservoir (2AZ) both require 6.5 Nm
